topic: Demonstration of real time data acquisition system
syllabus_extract: Demonstration of real time data acquisition system.
specific_objectives: 30.1.1.1 Trainee should be able to practical on various lab FTL, RF & Embedded lab.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Hands-on demonstration of DAQ system interfacing with sensors, safety checks on high voltage lines, and instructor supervision during signal injection.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a data acquisition system?
Name three types of sensors used in FTL labs.
Why is real-time data acquisition critical in RF environments?

development.content:
Introduction to DAQ hardware components
Signal conditioning and sensor interfacing
Real-time data processing algorithms
Safety protocols for embedded labs

topics: Configuration of FTL lab DAQ modules
development.content:
Configuration of FTL lab DAQ modules
Calibration of RF signal inputs
Troubleshooting common acquisition errors
Data logging and visualization techniques

Integration of embedded lab sensors
Analysis of acquired waveform data
Reporting standards for lab results
Maintenance of DAQ equipment

summary_questions: Explain the role of signal conditioning in DAQ systems.
How do you verify the accuracy of real-time data acquisition?
What steps are taken to ensure safety during embedded lab operations?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the differences between FTL and RF lab DAQ configurations for the next lesson.

pft_rows.syllabus: Operation of oscilloscope and function generator and its controls and observe waveform, measurement of various parameters of waveform.
